label: Issue 3
t: Photo ID to vote in the state constitution
what: Adds Ohio's existing photo-ID voting rules to the state constitution. In-person voters must show government-issued photo ID; absentee voters must provide photo ID or a signature plus one other identifier authorized by law. The legislature may create a separate verification process for voters with a religious objection to being photographed.
y: The photo-ID requirement for voting becomes part of the Ohio Constitution.
n: Photo ID stays required by state law only, which the legislature can change.
fiscal: No official fiscal estimate; the amendment largely constitutionalizes the photo-ID requirement already in state law.
pro: Ohio Republican Party, Senate Majority Leader Theresa Gavarone, Treasurer Robert Sprague, Vivek Ramaswamy, Amy Acton, President Trump
con: ACLU of Ohio, Ohio Citizen Action, Ohio Legislative Black Caucus, League of Women Voters of Ohio, Democratic legislators
